inputs.coefficient: local_exec_requests (replication report), per merge of 4 Compact sources

source_refs.claim: without zero-copy or a relink offer the sender streams the part files
the sender sends every checksummed file
each sent file is read through the disk: one GetObject per object on the sender
the receiver writes each received file: one PutObject per file
the receiver loads the fetched part from its disk
loading reads columns, checksums, index granularity, primary index and row count
a fetch writes a DownloadPart row to system.part_log
the age branch needs the entry at least prefer_fetch_merged_part_time_threshold (3600 s) old: a fresh entry is merged locally
a missing source part would make the replica fetch; every source is present here
on a content-addressed disk the sender offers a relink: the manifest, not the blobs
the receiver builds the part from shared-pool blob references, stages its own manifest and precommits it
